Integrated Curriculum Combos

ENGINEERING TRACK

JEE Integrated Combo 4-in-1

1. JEE (Main + Advanced) SyllabusIn-depth conceptual problem solving, shortcuts & simulated test series.
2. Complete Boards SyllabusFull CBSE & ISC Board theory, numericals & subjective answer writing.
3. Practical Lab SessionsHands-on laboratory experiments, project files, and school viva preparation.
4. CBT Mock Test SeriesComputer-Based Testing simulation, timed sectional drills & detailed question analysis.
Max 25 Students / BatchComplete Package
MEDICAL TRACK

NEET Integrated Combo 4-in-1

1. NEET-UG Comprehensive SyllabusLine-by-line NCERT mastery, speed drills, and full-length exam simulations.
2. Complete Boards SyllabusFull CBSE & ISC Board theory to secure 95%+ in Class 12 exams.
3. Practical Lab SessionsBiology, physics & chemistry lab experiments with teacher demonstrations.
4. CBT Mock Test SeriesComputer-Based Testing simulation, timed sectional drills & detailed question analysis.
Max 25 Students / BatchComplete Package
RESEARCH TRACK

IISER Integrated Combo 4-in-1

1. IISER PreparationAptitude & subject-focused prep for IISER Aptitude Test (IAT) across PCMB.
2. Board SyllabusFull CBSE & ISC Board coverage with solid conceptual & analytical fundamentals.
3. PracticalHands-on laboratory sessions, experimental analysis, and school viva preparation.
4. CBT Mock Test SeriesComputer-Based Testing simulation, timed sectional drills & detailed question analysis.
Max 25 Students / BatchComplete Package
